## Current role

Technical Lead at 1 BillionTech (Pvt) Limited, Colombo, Sri Lanka
(Aug 2025 – present). Defines the frontend architectural roadmap for
enterprise-grade products, architected micro-frontend and mono-repo systems
for multi-team autonomy, established TDD engineering standards, and cut
deployment cycles by ~30% through CI/CD and build-tool optimisation.

## Expertise

- Frontend architecture: React, TypeScript, Next.js, micro-frontends,
  mono-repos (Nx / Turborepo), server-side rendering
- Cross-platform mobile: React Native, Flutter, Ionic, native Android
- Engineering practice: SOLID, clean architecture, TDD/BDD, Jest, React
  Testing Library, Cypress, web performance optimisation, accessibility (WCAG)
- Design systems and component libraries
- Cloud and DevOps: AWS, Azure, Docker, CI/CD pipelines
- AI engineering: agentic systems, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG),
  LangGraph, hybrid vector search, locally hosted small language models
- Leadership: technical roadmapping, tech-debt management, mentorship,
  stakeholder communication

## Rewind (Android game)

> Rewind is a free physics puzzle game for Android in which the player cuts
> ropes to drop a glowing ball, the Ember, into a target vessel. Its defining
> mechanic is a limited rewind that reverses the last three seconds of play:
> the Ember retraces its path and cut ropes reattach, so a bad cut can be
> undone and retried rather than restarted.

- Page: https://pasinduweerakoon.com/rewind
- Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.pasindu.rewind
- Platform: Android 7.0+ · Price: free, ad-supported, no in-app purchases
- Offline: fully playable with no account and no connection
- Levels: 10 (World One); worlds two to four in development
- Scoring: three stars per level — finish it, collect all three tokens, use no rewinds
- Privacy policy: https://pasinduweerakoon.com/rewind/privacy
